calculations: Per-question undirected contrast graph on terminal graph-state indices: unique states, unique contrasts, connected components and incidence rank V-components
For each of two anchor groups, intersection of its twelve left/right endpoint pairs: test existence of a common center and twelve distinct leaves
Overlap between anchor stars, duplicate contrasts, and exact center-only explanation of right-in-left incidence
